items.title: Dutch Authorities Dismantle Botnet Linked to 17 Million Infected Devices
items.description: Dutch authorities have announced the takedown of a botnet that enslaved millions of infected devices, including computers, tablets, smartphones, and IoT devices, to carry out malicious attacks. items.title: Microsoft Releases KB5089573 for Windows 11 to Fix Patch Tuesday Install Issues
items.description: Microsoft has rolled out a new cumulative update, KB5089573, for Windows 11 versions 25H2 and 24H2, targeting a critical installation failure that affected users following the May 2026 Patch Tuesday release.
